entry_points.text: Out-of-line bit entries resolve the shared queue for word and bit, build a keyed waiter with optional deadline, then run the internal wait or lock loop.
Convenience wakes handle poll hangup with drain check, unkeyed sync, current-CPU, and bit-addressed wake via shared resolution.

exports.text: Domain repartitioning holds the domains mutex while delegating to the locked update.
Head init makes an empty protected queue; membership offers plain, exclusive tail, priority, conditional priority-exclusive with busy refusal, and removal.
Wakes cover current-CPU, caller-locked counted or keyed, lock-acquiring sync keyed tolerant of absence, locked sync keyed, unkeyed sync, and poll hangup with drain expectation.

Sleep setup links waiters recording task state, reports prior emptiness for exclusive entry, detaches with restart on pending signal, restores running on finish, binds entries to current with autoremove, and single interruptible sleep releases the lock across deschedule.
Woken coordination lets waiters skip sleep on marker or stop request and clear marker with ordering; wakers set it before default handling; autoremove detaches only on successful wake.

Bit waits resolve word plus bit to a shared queue, sleeping until clear via caller action or acquiring as lock by exclusive sleep plus atomic set; out-of-line forms add resolution and optional deadline; actions cover plain, IO, and timeout sleep.
Bit and variable wake filters accept only on address plus bit identity match with bit wake also requiring observed clear; variable entries bind current context with sentinel bit identity.

hazards.text: Poll hangup warns if the queue stays active after notify, indicating a waiter leak.
Priority-exclusive insert returns busy when a nonempty queue is already led by a priority waiter; callers must handle refusal.
Finish relies on lockless emptiness observation paired with locked mutation elsewhere; breaking the pairing risks stack-waiter lifetime errors.
Lock-acquiring sync keyed wake tolerates absent heads silently, while caller-locked forms require a valid head.
Deadline bit sleep reports again on expiry, distinct from interruption and successful wake.
List, locking, barrier, atomic bit, hash, time, container, lockdep and warn-once helpers are external dependencies owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Insertion mode sets markers: plain clears exclusivity, exclusive sets it, priority sets priority, combined sets both.
Exclusive waiters take tail, others head; event preparation preserves the choice from the waiter marker.
Re-preparation is idempotent, inserting only when detached; pending signals abort setup with restart and detachment, and bit actions report interruption.
Bit wait persists while the bit is observed set without action error; lock wait wins only via clear-to-set atomic transition; wake filtering needs address and bit equality plus clear for bit wake.
Shared queue index shifts the word address by five on 32-bit words and six otherwise, then mixes the bit number and hashes into table range.

locks.text: Domain repartitioning serializes by holding the domains mutex across the locked update.
Membership and marker changes hold the head lock with interrupts saved, including conditional priority-exclusive admission so lead check and refusal are atomic.
Caller-locked wakes require the head lock held; current-CPU and sync forms acquire internally; interruptible single sleep releases across deschedule and reacquires after.

state_machines.text: Waiter goes detached to queued with recorded sleep state and back to detached running on finish, which restores running before conditional detach.
Woken protocol ensures either sleeper sees the marker and skips sleep or waker sees sleep state; sleeper clears under ordering after waking, wakers set under barrier.
Autoremove retains waiter on failed wake and detaches exactly once on successful default handling, with bit and variable handlers delegating after filtering.
Bit lock wait loops exclusive sleep with conditional action and atomic acquire attempts until winning the set transition or action error.

structs.text: Head pairs a spin lock with a list anchor, initialized empty.
Entry carries flags, private context, wake callback and list node; default binds private to current and selects autoremove.
Bit entry embeds a wait entry plus key with flags-word reference, bit id and optional expiry; variable form uses sentinel id for address-only match.
Bit waiting multiplexes many words onto a fixed global head array indexed by hashed shifted address mixed with bit number.
Hash width is 8, giving 256 table entries as one shifted left by width.
Variable wait keys use negative one as bit identifier.
